title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 14

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the process-capability lesson take place?
tasks.audioText: The quality engineering tutor will discuss process capability on Friday at eleven. Students should bring the sample measurement table and the process glossary. The lesson will explain how variation in a process is compared with specification limits. The tutor will emphasise that a capability result depends on reliable data and appropriate assumptions.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which glossary is required for the process-capability lesson?
tasks.audioText: The quality engineering tutor will discuss process capability on Friday at eleven. Students should bring the sample measurement table and the process glossary. The lesson will explain how variation in a process is compared with specification limits. The tutor will emphasise that a capability result depends on reliable data and appropriate assumptions.

tasks.prompt: Process capability compares the variation of a process with the limits specified for a product feature. A capability index is meaningful only when the data are suitable and the process assumptions have been considered. A report should identify the measurement method, sample period and specification limits. It should not present a capability figure without explaining the context in which it was calculated. Reading 1. What does process capability compare?
options: Process variation with the specified product limits

tasks.prompt: Which context should a capability report identify?
options: Measurement method, sample period and specification limits

tasks.prompt: The capability result ___ with its measurement context.
Choose TWO details that support interpretation of a process-capability result.
options: The colour of the measurement table

tasks.prompt: The amount by which values differ from one another is process ___.
A capability index is presented without a sample period. What should you ask?
options: The sample period is not relevant.
Could you add the sample period and measurement method so the result can be interpreted?
I will remove the specification limits.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of process capability in a logical order.
options: Review the sample data and period
Identify the product feature and specification limits
Report the result with its context and assumptions
correctOrder: Identify the product feature and specification limits
Review the sample data and period
Report the result with its context and assumptions

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining what process capability compares and why a report must include measurement context and assumptions.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: process capability is explained as a comparison between process variation and specified limits (0–2); the response explains why measurement context, data and assumptions must accompany a report (0–2); limitations are acknowledged with understandable grammar (0–2); quality/statistics/measurement vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
